alt: Family walking past a bilingual roadside sign reading 'Lake Ontario, Now and Always' in English and French near Grimsby, Ontario, on August 29 2026, in response to the Trump administration's executive order renaming the lake
story: On August 29, 2026, Trump signed an executive order renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' as part of escalating trade tensions with Canada; Google Maps immediately updated it for U.S. users, while Canadian maps still say 'Lake Ontario' — making the same body of water officially three different names at once.
why_funny: Renaming a 400-year-old Great Lake by executive order doesn't change the water, the fish, or what Canadians see on their side of the border — it just means the most-used map app now disagrees with itself at the shoreline.
